title: Controlled Immutable B0 Evidence Retention
scope: evidence-governance contract, public B0 metadata register, run-lineage schema, external custodian handoff and controlled-storage proof interface only

verification.testing_scope_note: TESTED means cryptographic identity revalidation of the supplied bytes plus the previously validated JSON/run-lineage and branch-diff contract checks. The newly prepared storage-proof interface does not itself prove external retention. No historical ANIMO execution, scientific reference qualification or controlled-storage restore testing is claimed.

actions: establish legal/redistribution handling basis for each raw artifact
provision an authoritative immutable primary storage target
provision an independently recoverable secondary copy in a separate failure domain
ingest the exact three B0 byte objects without transformation
verify SHA-256 from retained bytes after ingest
perform and record a restore test followed by byte-hash verification
return only non-secret custody and immutability proof references using the storage-proof schema
update the B0 evidence register only after the proof record is reviewed

required_proof: post-ingest SHA-256 verification passed for all required B0 objects
secondary-copy SHA-256 verification passed for all required B0 objects
restore test passed with matching restored SHA-256 for all required B0 objects

prep_blockers.reason: EG01 qualifies the retention contract and implementation handoff only. Actual controlled immutable storage is not proven.

non_admissions: no raw proprietary or restricted artifact was copied into public Git
no legal redistribution permission is inferred
no external storage platform or custodian is assumed from this repository state
no historical reference environment is qualified
no diagnostic output is promoted to reference output
no ANIMO5 production migration is admitted
